desc: Call this to rotate the secret on an old API token with a short secret. Must be paired with a call to oauth.v2.completeShortTokenRotation to confirm the change.

client_id.desc: Issued when you created your application. Must be the app the token being rotated was issued to.

client_secret.desc: Issued when you created your application.

output.desc: New xoxp token of standard size that must be confirmed via oauth.v2.completeShortTokenRotation

new_token.desc: A new xoxp access token to replace the token with a shorter secret. Not yet active until completeShortTokenRotation is called.

invalid_client_id.desc: Value passed for `client_id` was invalid, or is not the app the token being rotated was issued to.

token_too_long.desc: This token is not short enough to be rotated.
